digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / gerrit-verify workflow / default test suite
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) advance to 99% progress then hang for 1.7–4.3 hours before manual cancellation; root cause is unconditional --filter=blob:none followed by read-tree + checkout-index with no up-front blob refill, causing sequential git-fetch RPCs per missing blob (~2.1h for 25,561 files in affected Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 that omit fix commit 96a0d5c3f).

Reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job omits timeout-minutes, so GitHub applies 360-minute default; six-hour execution bound allows manual-clear dependencies and prevents other jobs from executing; 60-minute bound matches documented 10–16m normal duration and preserves macOS margin.

Gerrit 1129 test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract times out due to FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignoring startAt/maxResults pagination parameters and returning the same non-empty issue list infinitely, while production _paged_search advances startAt and stops only on empty page.
